scope: Proposition 3.3 of the manuscript “Modularity of elliptic curves over imaginary quadratic fields” (preprints/Modularity-of-elliptic-curves-over-imaginary-quadratic-fields-October-4-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 030 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c74cc37755f500be), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose that k contains µm. At R = O, the special fiber of the model in Lemma 3.2 is a rational curve joined at distinct points to m copies of E, all defined over k. Rotations cyclically permute the elliptic components. The Jacobian family of Cm,R therefore extends to an abelian scheme on a Zariski neighborhood of O in the parameter curve, with fiber Em at O.
